Name: Xtarfur Valley - Sexperimental Edition
Author: Plebby999
Description:
A conversion to make [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27635]Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition[/url].

[b]Installation:[/b]
Install all the requirements for ACC and XDV SE.
Overwrite the portraits and sprites.

[b]Credits:[/b]
Original Anthro sprites, and portraits from Anthro Characters Continued by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2417747]Sion9000[/url] and [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/gaveliere.616423/]Gaveliere.
[/url]Original Xtardew sprites, and portraits by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399?tab=description]Psuedodiego.
[/url]﻿[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/zellgoma?gameId=1303]zellgoma[/url] and TeamLovePatrolAlpha for making the previous Xtarfur mods.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/132956868]MetaKage[/url] for the XVSE sprites, portaits, and animations.
